body: This PR adds options to include precipitation in radiation, specifically snow. Rather than adding a new lookup table for snow, we (me & claude) simply take the largest value from the cloud ice lookup table and use that for snow. We note that this choice is likely not 100% physically correct as snow can be much larger than ice, and is likely 3-4x too small of an assumption. However, this is a starting point to test the effects of adding snow to radiation and has improved the snow profile in the ClimaAtmos RCE box. This PR is built so that a different lookup table can be added for snow in the future. Currently, rain is not added to radiation, but this PR enables that option if someone wants to add it in. We add all of these choices to the documentation.
title: Add option to include snow in radiation
